scoring_justification: The checker can recompute the exact expected values for refractive index and thermo-optic coefficients using the model equations and the hidden test compound parameters (which are the same inputs the agent receives). This is a direct correctness check on the agent's implementation.

hidden_assets.purpose: Provide group-specific model constants and test compound parameters (bandgap, coefficients) to recompute expected n, dn/dT, dn/dP.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Constants are from the paper's Table 1; test compound parameters are synthetic but representative of the type needed for the model, consistent with the paper's data. They are not fabricated labels; they are the formula inputs required for recomputing the model outputs.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Constants directly copied from paper; test compound parameters constructed as plausible values using typical bandgaps and coefficients from the paper's Tables 2-4 and references. No randomness.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual model inputs; any correct implementation must produce the same outputs from these inputs, so the gold is deterministic and verifiable.

outputs.description: Computed refractive indices and thermo-optic coefficients. The hidden checker compares each predicted value against the paper's reported values within tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The model constants and test compound parameters are provided in the instruction. The agent must implement the Penn-gap model equations and compute the three quantities. No external data download is required.

steps.description: Recompute expected refractive indices and thermo-optic coefficients from hidden test compound parameters and group constants; check that agent's computed values match within tolerances.
